nodes.label: Restaurant Interior Hallway
nodes.description: Interior corridor of The District restaurant featuring a large graffiti-style stacked burger mural with integrated text reading 'The District' and 'Kingston', topped by a golden crown illustration. Neon teal/cyan LED strip lighting frames the mural, creating a vivid glowing atmosphere. Framed artworks line the surrounding walls, reflecting an art-forward, urban street-art aesthetic. The image communicates bold brand identity, youthful energy, and a curated dining environment. Used on the restaurant website for interior ambiance and brand storytelling.
nodes.visual_style: street art / graffiti, neon-lit, high-contrast, colorful
nodes.purpose: interior ambiance photography, brand identity showcase
